params.cache_key_format: JSON object string keys holding decimal n

constants.centered_operator: (S - S^-1)/2 (skew-adjoint; i times it is Hermitian)
constants.centered_binary_identity: d-th unnormalised centered difference of 2^(r-1) is 3^d * 2^(r-1-d)
constants.xlsx_cap_note: dyadic-difference-tables.xlsx caps at r = 50 because a spreadsheet carries ~15 significant digits; Python ints have no such limit
constants.o10_note: O10 is a deliberate gap in the series and is not filled by this script

repeat_relation.backward: zero at depth d <=> gap-1 (adjacent) repeat at depth d-1
repeat_relation.centered: zero at depth d <=> gap-2 repeat at depth d-1; the adjacent-repeat relation does NOT hold
